newsitem.title: JAPAN: Small LIFFE Euroyen volume natural - official.
newsitem.headline: Small LIFFE Euroyen volume natural - official.

text.p: LIFFE officials said on Tuesday that while they will consider measures to increase the popularity of their three-month Euroyen futures, they felt its small turnover on LIFFE was inevitable.

"One should never expect the volumes of derivatives products...outside the time zone of the underlying market to be as great as the volume of turnover...in the home market," Jack Wigglesworth, chairman of the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) said at a press lunch.
He said LIFFE is now setting up a working party with the Tokyo International Financial Futures Exchange (TIFFE) to consider ways of increasing volume.
Daniel Hodson, chief executive of LIFFE, said Euroyen volume in London will never be more than a fraction of the Euroyen in Tokyo.
In October, average daily volume of three-month Euroyen futures on LIFFE was 1,004 contracts, compared with 88,928 contracts on TIFFE.
Regarding JGB options, which are not yet traded on LIFFE, Hodson said that while they may become available in the future, there are no plans to begin trading now.
